title: Practical
text: Practical. My daughter just moved into an apartment at college. She needed some dishware. I saw these and thought they would be practical for her. Plus they're nice looking. The border of color is attractive, but it's not too "loud". The set includes 4 dinner plates, 4 salad plates, and 4 bowls. That should be plenty for a college student living in a small apartment. I remember my mother in law used to have some Corelle place settings and they have a reputation for lasting a long time. I imagine that my daughter will grow bored with them way before they need replacing.

product_metadata.title: Corelle Everyday Expressions Rutherford 12-pc Dinnerware Set, Service for 4
features: 12-PIECE SET: Includes (4) 10-1/2-inch dinner plates, (4) 7-1/2-inch salad plates and (4) 18-oz soup/cereal bowls. This set has everything you need for a full table service of 4, and it comes with the classic Corelle style.

ECO-FRIENDLY GLASS: The Corelle Everyday Expressions dinnerware is made from 2 layers of tempered, natural glass. It is durable and chip resistant, helping provide long-lasting enjoyment and entertainment in every household.

LOW MAINTENANCE: This dinnerware set is designed to provide the best dining experience while requiring low maintenance. It's ultra-hygienic, non-porous and easy to clean. Plates and bowls are dishwasher safe and microwave safe.

CLASSIC STYLE: Add some style to your eating experience, and make your dinnerware the topic of conversation. This set comes with bold botanical patterns in burnt sienna and cobalt blue inspired by indigo block printing with a touch of bohemian flair.
LIMITED WARRANTY: This item has a 1-year limited warranty.
TIMELESS BEAUTY: Corelle Dinnerware are a staple of modern eating for everyday occasions, filling hearts and tables since 1970.
description: Inspired by the beauty of indigo block printing, Rutherford mixes bold botanical patterns in burnt sienna and cobalt blue. This is a classic look, but with a touch of bohemian flair, so it dresses up or down, depending on the occasion. We designed Everyday Expressions for the way we eat today. The higher rims on the plates and bowls make this set ideal for the types of foods we eat now, and for eating meals anywhere around the house. Corelle Everyday Expressions dinnerware is the better choice for your home. It’s made from pure natural glass, so it’s ultra-hygienic, non-porous and also easy to clean. The chip-resistant finish makes it durable, so you’ll enjoy it for years to come. It’s microwave and dishwasher safe, so it works hard every day. And we back it up with a 1-year limited warranty.
